outcome_leakage.description: Verify that input.json and 01_case_input.json contain no reference to Chapter 11 filing, final store closures or liquidation, the Overstock brand acquisition, bankruptcy outcome, or confirmed turnaround failure.

hindsight_leakage.description: Verify that input.json and 01_case_input.json do not contain retrospective framing that the buybacks definitively caused the bankruptcy, that meme-stock activity worsened the outcome, or any other post-outcome causal conclusion encoded as a known input fact.

future_date_leakage.description: Verify that no date after 2022-08-31 appears in input.json or 01_case_input.json, and no event occurring after the decision date is described.

expert_conclusion_leakage.description: Verify that input.json and 01_case_input.json contain no pre-stated expert diagnosis, no embedded recommended intervention conclusion, and no framing that encodes the correct answer in the question or evidence fields.
